[Am]Please beware of them that
stare They'll only smile to
[E]see you while Your time
away And once you've seen
what [Csus2/F]they have been To
win the earth just won't
[E7sus4]seem worth Your night or your
[E7]day Who'll hear what I
[Am]say. Look around you find
the ground Is not so
[E]far from where you are
But not too wise For
[Csus2/F]down below they never grow
They're always tired and charms
[E7sus4]are hired From out of their
[E7]eyes Never surprise. Take your
time [Csus2/F]and you'll be fine
And say a prayer for
[E7sus4]people there Who live on the
[E7]floor And if you see
[Am]what's meant to be Don't
name the day or try
[E]to say It happened before.
what you'll say About the
farmers [Csus2/F]and the fun And
the things behind the sun
[E7sus4]And the people round your head
[E7]Who say everything's been said
[Am]And the movement in your
brain Sends you out into
[E]the rain.
